user.title: Connect to Cellarion
user.description: How do you want to authenticate?

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with Cellarion
reauth_confirm.description: Your Cellarion credentials are no longer valid. How do you want to re-authenticate?

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Cellarion
reconfigure.description: Change the instance URL or the credentials.

token.title: Connect with an API token
token.description: Create a token with the read and consume scopes in Cellarion under Settings → API tokens, then paste it here.

password.title: Connect with email & password
password.description: On Cellarion servers with API-token support, a scoped token is created for Home Assistant and your password is not stored.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Cellarion. Check the URL.
error.invalid_token: This API token was not accepted (revoked or mistyped).
error.token_scope: This API token is missing the read scope. Create one with both the read and consume scopes.
error.invalid_url: That does not look like a valid instance URL. Check the address and try again.
error.account_mismatch: These credentials are for a different Cellarion account than this entry. Re-authenticate with the original account, or remove this entry and add the other account separately.

abort.already_configured: This Cellarion account is already configured.

scope_missing.message: The Cellarion API token lacks a required scope: {error}

multiple_accounts.message: Multiple Cellarion accounts are configured; pass entry_id to choose one.

consume_bottle.name: Consume bottle
consume_bottle.description: Mark a bottle in your Cellarion cellar as consumed (drank, gifted, sold, or other). Frees its rack slot and updates your statistics.

bottle_id.name: Bottle ID
bottle_id.description: The Cellarion bottle id to consume.

reason.name: Reason
reason.description: Why the bottle left the cellar.

rating.name: Rating
rating.description: Optional rating to record with the consumption.

note.name: Note
note.description: Optional tasting note or comment (max 1000 characters).

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Only needed when multiple Cellarion accounts are configured.

push_forbidden.title: Cellarion instant updates unavailable
push_forbidden.description: The configured API token does not have the 'read' scope, so instant (push) updates are disabled. Create a new token with the read scope in Cellarion → Settings → API tokens and reconfigure the integration. Polling continues to work in the meantime.
